0022600109.text: The San Antonio Spurs (0-2), 5th in the Southwest and 12th in the West, visit the Dallas Mavericks (1-1, 3rd in the Southwest) for their third game of the 2026-27 season, looking for their first win after losing both home games. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Jett Howard (calf soreness), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Kyrie Irving (rest), Max Christie (leg), Morez Johnson Jr. (lower leg) and Zaccharie Risacher (hip soreness) are day-to-day, with Christie, Johnson and Risacher listed as game-time decisions. The Spurs won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season series, including a 139-120 win in San Antonio on April 10, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
